subject: How do I constrain paths between latent factors to be equal?

messages.author: 42a8db694a549d17
messages.subject: How do I constrain paths between latent factors to be equal?
parts:
Hi all,

I am running some CFA models but am a little bit stuck. I have a three factor model, specified like this:

free_model <- '
factor1 =~ m1a + m1b + m1c
factor2 =~ m2a + m2b + m2c
factor3 =~ m3a + m3b
# regressions
factor3 ~ factor1
factor3 ~ factor2
# residual correlation
m1a ~~ m1b
'
This allows me to see the freely varying paths between factors. Next, I would like to constrain the paths between some factors to be equal (e.g., the paths from factors 1 & 2 to factor 3), but I'm not sure of the syntax needed to achieve this. Any advice would be very much appreciated. Thank you!

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: How do I constrain paths between latent factors to be equal?
parts:
you can use labels, the same label indicates the parameters will be equal

factor3 ~ p1*factor1
factor3 ~ p1* factor2

Now, this is only relevant if the predictors are in the same metric, to ensure this I recommend you to add std.lv=T when calling cfa() or sem(), this way all factors will be in a standfardized metric
